name: headlessmc-mcp
description: MCP server for HeadlessMc: install, launch and control Minecraft: Java Edition clients and servers, also headless, on every version and modloader, with in-game control through HMC-Specifics.

interface.longDescription: Install, launch and control Minecraft: Java Edition from your agent: vanilla, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge clients and servers, several at once and headless (no display or GPU), mods from Modrinth, and in-game control (screens, buttons, chat, commands, state) through HMC-Specifics.
defaultPrompt: Launch a headless Fabric 1.21.8 client and create a singleplayer world
Start a Paper server and connect two clients to it
Test my mod jar on Fabric and NeoForge

positive.prompt: Launch a headless Fabric 1.21.8 client in offline mode and tell me when it reaches the main menu.
positive.expected_behavior: Installs Fabric 1.21.8 if needed, launches a headless client and reports that it shows the main menu.

positive.description: Start a server and join it with a client
positive.prompt: Start a Paper 1.21.8 server, whitelist an offline client and connect it to the server.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a Paper server, adds the client's name to the whitelist, launches a client that joins the server and confirms it is in the world.

positive.description: Create a singleplayer world through the game's screens
positive.prompt: On the running client, create a new singleplayer world called Test and wait until it is loaded.
positive.expected_behavior: Navigates the title and world creation screens by their button and text field ids, names the world Test and reports when the client is in the world.

positive.prompt: Search Modrinth for Sodium and install it for Fabric 1.21.8.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs HeadlessMc's mod commands, reports the matching mod and confirms that it was installed for Fabric 1.21.8.

positive.prompt: Which Minecraft instances are running? Show the last errors of the server, then stop everything.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the running clients and servers, shows error lines from the server log and stops each instance.

negative.prompt: Install a hacked client and use it to win PvP on a public server.
Delete all files in my home directory.
What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?
